title: Vision
description: A lightweight client-side Fullbright mod for adjusting brightness with a percentage-based Vision system.
body:
# ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d330f923a256077598c6ca729f1a35f2cc359c9.png)

Vision is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod by **rollotom2** with **_Clevora Studios_** that lets you adjust Minecraft brightness with a simple percentage-based Vision system.

`0%` represents normal Minecraft brightness, positive values make the game brighter, and negative values make the game darker.

## ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/515670d807f61472ff313fc956e038a2897ecee9.png)

- Percentage-based Vision brightness system
- Default keybind: **G**
- **Arrow Up** / **Arrow Down** brightness adjustment
- Configurable lowest and highest Vision values
- Configurable Vision step value
- Optional smooth Vision transitions
- Configurable transition duration
- Negative Vision value support
- Custom Vision message and message color
- Mod Menu configuration screen
- Client-side only
- ...


## ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2bb9a25c96e2951924e92f32dc7955a6167403b5_0.webp)

- **G** — Switch between lowest and highest Vision value
- **Arrow Up** — Increase Vision
- **Arrow Down** — Decrease Vision

All keybinds can be changed in Minecraft's controls menu.

## ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1379b03719d5c547a7cc98fd0ed5634cbcb67b1.png)
 
Vision can be configured through Mod Menu.

You can adjust:

- Current Vision value
- Lowest and highest toggle values
- Vision step value
- Vision message text
- Vision message color
- Message visibility
- Mod enabled state
- ...

## ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d70d6088d85ac4af3faa4b6580d156adbb86c9b1.png)

- Minecraft: **1.21.11**
- Loader: **Fabric**
- Environment: **Client-side**

## ![​](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94ebf7abbcf59084ed53231c5e193de80a6a59b7.png)
 
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config API
